decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording that the included brand colour details are required rather than a separate logo-guidelines document; no additional update or removal is necessary.
Clarifying the level of font guidance included in the fixed cost does not change the selected logo design, letterforms, or visual treatment.

The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY limiting delivery to the three specified colour variants and a RESUME resolving its prior ambiguity; the font-guidance clarification adds no further change.
The clarification about included brand font information does not alter the required logo file types or their digital and print application coverage.
The fixed-cost font-information clarification does not change the completed concept and revision process.
